clips.title: The story
paras: Argent Guard Thaelrid is a wounded night elf scout sent by the Argent Dawn into the submerged ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. Trapped near the Pool of Ask'ar, he bears witness to the dark alliance taking root between the naga and the Twilight's Hammer cult.

When strange reports trickled out of the Zoram Strand concerning foul rites deep beneath the sea, the Argent Dawn took interest. Dedicated to watching for rising evils and unnatural corruption across Azeroth, the order dispatched Scout Thaelrid to slip inside Blackfathom Deeps. His mission was simple: assess the depth of the threat, observe the movements within the flooded temple, and report back so the Dawn could decide where aid was most desperately needed.
